violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee Pizza maker observed without proper hair restraint.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Reach-in-Freezer needs cleaned of food debris.

Food-contact surfaces - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface was not disassembled for proper cleaning. - Large slicer had pieces of meat and onions stuck to it. Needs to be properly cleaned between uses.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. - Boxes of single use items on floor in dry storage room and closet located in conference room.
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
Handwashing, good hygienic practices (5 pts deducted)
Bare hand contact avoided, single- use gloves, and utensils used (3 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
